target: scaffold.sh status — a region-managed file reports regions-updatable, not modified
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.10.0; mkdir -p fake/templates/workflows .claude/workflows scripts/lib; cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh" scripts/lib/workflow.sh; printf '%s\n' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=p owner=plugin' 'const P = "v2"' '// @agentic-loop:end region=p' > fake/templates/workflows/factory.js; printf '%s\n' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=p owner=plugin' 'const P = "v1"' '// @agentic-loop:end region=p' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=mine owner=project' 'const MINE = 1' '// @agentic-loop:end region=mine' > .claude/workflows/factory.js; scaffold_status fake software-unattended | awk -F'\t' '$1==".claude/workflows/factory.js" {print $2}' | jq -R '{state: .}'
_note: guards the whole point of region ownership: a project workflow that legitimately differs from the template (it carries a project-owned region) must NOT be reported as `modified` — that verdict is what forced projects to choose between customizing and ever updating again.
